Hi Neha / Stephanie,

We started seeing elevated 5xx and 429 responses to our production calls to the Redwood Core API at ~08:40 PDT. This is affecting checkout flows for a subset of our customers and we need an immediate mitigation plan and visibility into what happened. Please advise ETA to restore normal error rates and whether this incident qualifies for SLA credits — our legal team will expect formal remediation.

Thanks,

On Thu, Jul 2, 2026 at 09:22 AM Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com> wrote:
> Immediate next steps:

Quick update from infra: we're seeing a retry surge from a small group of CoreAPI clients originating from a single IP range hitting the streaming generate endpoint. That pattern is amplifying backend load and exhausting a hot shard's connection pool, causing 5xx cascades.

Mitigation applied (09:40 PDT):
- Scoped connection pool increase on the hot shard.
- Short-term per-client rate cap at edge (not a global throttle) to drain the queue.
- Added circuit-breaker to drop dup requests seen from fast retries.

Error rate dropped to ~2.1% after mitigation but we continue monitoring. I'll push a short write-up to INF-4821 and share traces.

Ethan Park
SRE, Redwood Inference
